Episode 254: The Egos of the Sun God (1)
After securing Beltian, Jin did not rest for a moment and immediately headed for the West Sea of the Lutero Federation to support Kinzelo.
However, he did not lead all the troops that had fought in the battle against Beltian.
People like Van, Ameris, and Lucy had to use their strength to stabilize Beltian's restraint and move him to the place where the main hall's power source should be located.
Furthermore, the rest of the troops had to be redeployed throughout their territory to prepare for the Zipples' retaliatory massacres of civilians, so only three people headed for the West Sea.
Jin, Murakan, and Bligiet.
[Ah, this hurts my pride. We're just about to get started, and you guys have already captured Beltian and come to support us?]
Orgal said as he watched Jin and his companions disembark from the flagship Sarah.

Thanks to his combat experience across multiple dimensions and the sun energy he possessed, Orgal knew how to call forth the egos of the Sun God who had stopped their existence, but he could not be as fast as Bligiet.
Because of that, Nepdol was only just now about to awaken.

[Well, whatever. What's there to be prideful about? Our Kinzelo was busy getting beaten up by you guys all the time anyway. It's better for my mental health to just think what's good is good. Since it turned out this way, let's just capture Nepdol even faster than Beltian.]
Although Orgal was speaking self-deprecatingly, Bligiet was astonished by his ability.
[...To think I never imagined a mortal could find one of us who has stopped our existence. You are incredible, Orgal Remillias. That is something that even Jin or Van here cannot do.]

[Compared to you, who are the creator of this world, I may be insignificant, but I have also lived quite diligently in numerous dimensions. Now, I will wake him, so everyone prepare for battle. Those who haven't gone to the bathroom, go now. Tsk, seeing as Beltian, an ego of destruction, was beaten so one-sidedly, Nepdol will be no contest. Especially since we have the memory of the beginning.]
[Nepdol will be much more open to conversation. Perhaps we won't need to be as cruel as we were with Beltian.]
Soon, Orgal began to send an invisible energy into the sea, just as Bluggiet had done when he awoke Beltian.
Pahhaaaaaa...!
At that, the surrounding sea began to vibrate, and whirlpools bloomed like flowers in various places.

Before a few seconds had passed, those massive whirlpools were dyed with solar energy and soared up like waterspouts, and the sun energy that poured from them instantly colored the entire sea a dazzling golden hue.
[Kuh, what a magnificent sight. It's beautiful, very.]
[A... mortal... has awoken... me?]
Nepdol's voice was heard from the empty air.
Before long, he revealed his form, which was, surprisingly, like that of an octopus.
A smooth, shining golden head was the first to rise, parting the sea, and next to it, equally shining tentacles shot up.
[I can never get used to this friend's appearance, no matter how many times I see it. Was it because he is the ego who loves the sea the most among our creations that he has this form?]
[That's right, Orgal.]
[Still, there must have been many other cool things besides an octopus. Like a whale...]
While the party was momentarily dumbfounded by Nepdol's appearance, Nepdol quickly read the situation, scratching his head with his two closest tentacles.
[Bluggiet, my other self who will recreate the world with me. What has happened? Why are you restrained by mortals and helping them?]
As Bluggiet had said, Nepdol did not show an immediate hostile reaction like Beltian.
Jin and his companions also did not draw their weapons for the time being.
[My dear Nepdol, I have awoken you from your long slumber because I have something to show you.]
[Something to show me...? No, th-that is!]
[Yes, the memory of the beginning.]
[Sob... hic...!]
The ego of Reconstruction was more vulnerable to the memory of the beginning compared to the ego of Destruction.
Jin recalled what Bluggiet had said a few hours ago and shook his head.
'Although he is in a vulnerable state, having just awoken from a stopped existence... at this point, it seems the egos of the Sun God have a severe case of depression.'
Nepdol continuously wiped away his tears with his shining, octopus-leg-like tentacles.
The party suddenly felt a strange sense of unease at the sight of a giant golden octopus that had eyes like a human and was wiping away tears like a human.
“It's kind of cute... don't you think, kid. Strawberry Pie has a thing for cute stuff. I'd like to show it to her. I'll have to show it to her after it's been restrained and made safe.”
“Uh. Yeah, she'd like that...”
For a while, the sight of the rainbow-colored flashing sun energy and Nepdol bursting into tears in front of it continued.

[Nepdol, do you remember? We created this world because we were lonely. And we felt love. That love was, in fact, completed because the world was incomplete. That all beings can love each other because they all have flaws is an immutable truth that has continued from the beginning until now. It even applies to us, before we were scattered like this...]
[Sob, y-you're right... Bluggiet. Love is about filling each other's sharp and empty places. One can only enter if there is a gap...]
At that answer, Bluggiet wiped his nose with his thumb, then approached Nepdol and held out his hand.
There was a strange, moving quality to the sight of the normally human-sized Bluggiet and the giant-monster-like Nepdol trying to shake hands.

[Nepdol, if you have reawakened that precious heart, then from now on, be with me, with us. There is no need for you and I to act like the egos of destruction, saying the world must be reconstructed.]
Slowly, the hands and tentacles of the two Sun Gods facing each other were getting closer.
Then, the moment the tips of the hand and tentacle were about to touch, suddenly, the sight of Nepdol's tentacle swatting Bluggiet away like a fly followed.
[Ugh]

[Stop with the nonsense, you crazy bastard! That's right, love is beautiful because it is done by incomplete beings. But what is the reality? How did the mortals we created treat each other? They hated, killed, and blasphemed each other for pathetic reasons! Beings like that don't deserve to love, nor do they deserve to know love. This world must be made anew!]
Crash, slap, boom!
While he was shouting in an excited voice, a barrage of consecutive tentacle strikes ceaselessly battered Bluggiet.
Every time the sea was overturned by a tentacle strike, Bluggiet would bounce up and sink like a fish, over and over again.
[Ooh... that's got to hurt. In many ways.]
“Why are all the creator-gods like this? Generally, they're at the level of a brainless immortal.”
[Kraaaaaak! Nepdol, since you're an ego of Reconstruction like me, I tried to treat you with as much respect as possible, but this won't do! You've just won the spot of my subordinate number 2!]
Bluggiet shouted as he barely managed to shove the memory of the beginning in front of Nepdol's eyes again.
[Hic, sob.]
Of course, Nepdol was once again swept up in intense sorrow and became defenseless, and the members of the coalition and Kinzelo drew their weapons as if they had no other choice.
[Jin, how much time did you say is needed to reuse the restraining equipment?]
“Two days.”

[Then that means we have to fight for two full days. Let's think of it as practice for coordinating. We'll have to watch each other's backs a lot in the future. Except for you, I've already matched up with the rest of your companions.]
Jin did not answer and quietly watched Orgal.
It wasn't the first time he had seen Orgal fight since they had become something like allies, but it was the first time he was seeing him use his full strength.
He was already leaping towards Nepdol, cloaked in a dense aura energy like that of Helluram's, as if it were armor.
The following flash of his sword was a perfect strike that made even Jin's eyes widen for a moment.
'Those countless battles he fought in other dimensions, all that experience is perfectly melted into a single sword...'
Every time Orgal swung his sword, Nepdol's giant tentacles were cut away powerlessly.
And before the regeneration by solar energy could even begin, soldiers of the Abyss Legion appeared from somewhere and stuck to the wounds.
Orgal Remillias.
He was, undoubtedly, the mortal who had fought the most battles across all dimensions.
'If he put his mind to it, he is at a level where he could trouble our coalition as much as the Tower of Stories.'
Suddenly, he felt that it was a relief that Orgal had come to form an alliance on his own.
Although he still didn't feel close enough to call him a 'companion,' he also felt that it would be alright to trust him to some extent.
If only to fight against the great evils, the Zipple and the unified Zipple.
Soon, Jin naturally entered Orgal's attack trajectory and began to launch a combined assault.
[Oh, we have good synergy from the start. I tried to match up roughly, referencing the tendencies of the Siron and Luna I had experienced, and it seems it was the right choice.]

“From the looks of it, if we continuously deal damage and miniaturize him like Beltian and then subdue him, I won't have to be here for two full days. Rather, what I'm concerned about is the interference of the Zipple and Ganesto this time as well, but since they didn't have much leeway during the Beltian fight, I doubt they'll be a variable.”

[That's right. If we capture Nepdol as well, we will possess more egos of the Sun God than the Zipple. However, Bligiet, Beltian, and Nepdol. Even the three of them combined cannot compare to Malugia.]
“Still, we can control three egos without much difficulty, whereas the Zipple's Malugia... Lady Elona, can be called a time bomb in some ways. According to Bligiet, that is.”
[Let's just hope that bomb explodes in a way that is beneficial to our side.]
Jin, Murakan, and Orgal and Kinzelo dealt with Nepdol with great leisure. It took less than five hours for Nepdol to change into a restrainable, small form.
[Kkyuuk, kkyu...]
The miniaturized Nepdol, unlike Beltian, maintained its octopus form.
Nepdol, who had turned into a golden octopus about the size of a watermelon, revealed an appearance so cute it was hard to fight him anymore.
“Orgal, it seems Murakan and I can return now.”
[Yeah, it was quite fun fighting together. Leave Bligiet here. We have to watch Nepdol together until the restraining equipment arrives.]
“Are you telling me to leave two egos of the Sun God in your care and depart?”
The moment Orgal heard Jin's reply, he flared up and glared, and was about to shout, "You still don't trust me?"
However, Jin observed his reaction, smirked, and answered.
“It was a joke. I'll be waiting and trusting you, so finish up well, Orgal.”
